engineGaps.requirement: H1 in capitals and H2 in Title Case while the conjunctions ve/veya/ile stay lowercase (“MATERYAL ve METOT”).
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: schema.d.ts TextStyle.textTransform is only "none"|"uppercase"|"lowercase"|"capitalize" (CSS semantics) — uppercase/capitalize would also transform “ve”; no exception list. generatedIndex.matchHeadingTransform would propagate the same error to the TOC.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: Optional TextStyle.textTransformExceptions: string[] (words kept lowercase, locale tr) applied in editor/PDF/DOCX/TOC; or use textTransform "none" and rely on author input + an advisory validation rule.

engineGaps.requirement: Page numbers in Times New Roman 10 pt while body is 12 pt.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: schema.d.ts NumberingRule has only enabled/position/align/format/startAt/restart — no font family/size; PageRule.footer has no style.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: NumberingRule.style?: Partial<TextStyle> (fontFamily, fontSizePt) honoured by the sheet chrome, layout PDF and DOCX PAGE-field run properties.

engineGaps.requirement: Caption label “Şekil 3.1”/“Tablo 3.1” bold, caption text regular.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: schema.d.ts CaptionRule.style is a single TextStyle for the whole caption; no label/number style.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: CaptionRule.labelStyle?: Partial<TextStyle> applied to “label + number” run(s).

engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: Engine splits long tables by row (README Pagination) but has no continuation caption; CaptionRule has no continuation text.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: CaptionRule.continuation?: { enabled, suffix: "(Devamı)", position: "afterNumber" } rendered on each continuation fragment (PDF) and as repeated header caption in DOCX.

engineGaps.requirement: Heading spacing expressed as “one empty 1.5-spaced line” before/after, plus 6 pt paragraph before/after with Word additive semantics.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: TextStyle spaceBeforePt/spaceAfterPt exist, but editor CSS margins collapse (max) while Word adds after+before; there is no declared spacing-combination model, so editor/PDF and DOCX can differ by 6 pt per boundary.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: typography.paragraphSpacingModel: "word-additive" | "collapse" applied consistently in CSS (e.g. padding instead of margin) and DOCX; optional unit “emptyLines” for spacing.

engineGaps.requirement: Symbols & abbreviations list with definitions aligned on a common tab stop, single spacing.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: No tab-stop support in TextStyle/sections; listOfSymbols is only an editable section.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: Section-level `tabStops: [{ positionMm, align, leader }]` for editable sections (CSS tab-size / grid in editor, w:tabs in DOCX), or a two-column borderless table style.

engineGaps.requirement: Individual landscape pages for wide figures/tables with the page number kept bottom-centre of the portrait page.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: Orientation is per section (overrides.page Partial<PageRule>); main content is one editable section, so a single rotated page inside it is not expressible.
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: Block-level “rotate page” for a figure/table (landscape sheet with portrait chrome).

engineGaps.requirement: Bibliography: separate numbered “İnternet Kaynakları” list (1-, 2-, …) cited in text as (İnt.Kyn.n).
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: bibliography has only heading/style/hangingIndentMm/citationStyle; no sub-list grouping or numbered secondary citation key.

engineGaps.requirement: Table notes below tables at 11 pt single spacing.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: No table-note construct; authors must style a paragraph manually (no per-paragraph style presets in schema).
engineGaps.suggestedGenericCapability: CaptionRule.noteStyle (tables) for a “table note” paragraph type.

engineGaps.requirement: Generated lists: title only on first page; “Sayfa” heading directly below the title, right aligned, bold.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: Expressible (generatedIndex.pageHeading/pageHeadingStyle); no gap, listed for verification only — confirm pageHeading is not repeated on continuation pages if required.

engineGaps.requirement: Front-matter pages counted but unnumbered / Özet starts at i.
engineGaps.whyEngineCannot: Expressible (numbering.enabled false + restart at abstract). No gap.
